name: Hydra Broodmaster
oracle_text:
{X}{X}{G}: Monstrosity X. (If this creature isn't monstrous, put X +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.)
When this creature becomes monstrous, create X X/X green Hydra creature tokens.
blocked_sentences: When this creature becomes monstrous, create X X/X green Hydra creature tokens.

needs.what: an X/X green Hydra creature token (no abilities), e.g. hydra_x_x_g, whose power/toughness are set by create_token's power/toughness from the monstrosity X
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is closed and has no Hydra token; the nearest is ooze_x_x_g, a green X/X Ooze, which has the wrong creature type. Monstrosity X (op monstrosity) and the becomes_monstrous trigger event both exist, so the token is the only missing piece
